Packaging and Installation contracts supply actual archive/install and npm artifact boundaries; the plan's prior-work reconciliation prevents this review from claiming a separate support-retirement initiative complete.

Population, source composition and maintenance — pass. The eight directly discovered adapter groups own metadata (11), archives (14), mapped resources (3), clean installation (11), portability (15), generation/drift (19), diagnostics (5) and public/workflow contracts (17), totaling 95. The aggregate imports these native TestCase classes without aliases, borrowed test methods or duplicate discovery. Plain fixture/build/command functions expose their operational purpose; per-case setup owns actual lifecycle state. The reviewer reran m5_compare_source.py: every original adapter test body remains equivalent after declared helper-call normalization, and the 73 recording statements preserve order after explicit interrupted-child cwd normalization. Full source assessment, rather than AST equivalence alone, establishes that preservation is useful.

Test coverage and failure sensitivity — pass. All seven original npm scenarios remain, and PackedRecordingTests.test_installed_target_supports_explicit_and_primary_recording exposes the formerly hidden ordered integration as one additional native case. Actual tarball observations now use an independent literal 20-member runtime/trust/schema/template inventory, with separately asserted candidate metadata, forbidden members and package policy. The inspected omission probe removes command-result.js from an actual packed archive while reducing the producer's required set: the former focused assertion passes and the strengthened case fails without setup errors. This supports a focused oracle improvement, not a claim that the entire old suite missed an unusable package.

Archive, metadata, resource and install families — pass; retain meaningful protection. Tests observe real ZIP membership and raw bytes for both literal supported targets, canonical skill/resource contents and the declared Claude metadata transformation. Candidate hashes, sizes, file counts, target roots, missing/stale/wrong-target artifacts and complete resource propagation remain checked. Clean installation launches real CLI children before any missing/stale/unowned-resource mutation, guards successful setup, and checks boundary-specific diagnostics. A fake successful runner cannot substitute for installed files. Selection errors and missing archives reject before effects. Narrow producer-derived setup domains are not the sole complete-inventory oracle: independent canonical membership and literal two-target observations remain.

Portability, generation and diagnostic families — pass; retain meaningful variants. All 15 portability cases retain named Unicode/HTML/Markdown, shell/math/variable/path, invocation/install/capability, explicit-alternative and phrase-boundary variants with distinct intended outcomes and effective mutation guards. All 19 generation cases retain canonical/active-output containment, parent/runtime/symlink/hardlink/FIFO safety, independent target packages, transformed metadata, manifest-first ordering, missing/malformed/stale/unexpected content, no persistent cache and structured security failures. These outcomes justify retaining the groups rather than consolidating by textual similarity.
